articles.title: Live markets: bitcoin sentiment in 'absolute gutter' as price slips below $75,000
articles.snippet: Memory chip stocks are attracting capital and attention, with crypto markets settling into apathy.

articles.title: Bitcoin gauge tracking selling pressure moves into 'high-risk' zone as ETF demand slumps
articles.snippet: U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs have accumulated a net 4,500 BTC since the start of 2026, with May reversing the buying pattern that built through March and April, per Swissblock data.

articles.title: Sold in May and went away? Bitcoin risks another 10% drop as month turns red
articles.snippet: Bitcoin is on track to end May in the red, a historically bearish signal that could point to deeper losses ahead if the post-May track record is any guide.

articles.title: Sharplink, Forward Industries among crypto firms considered for Russell indexes
articles.snippet: Bitmine and Galaxy Digital may also be eligible for the Russell 1000, an index tracking the largest 1,000 US companies that includes Nvidia, Microsoft and Apple.
